threads.body: `CommonConfig` derives `v3Preview` only from declarative config (`commonConfig.getBoolean("v3_preview", false)`). When the SDK is not an `ExtendedOpenTelemetry` (non-declarative mode), `DeclarativeConfigUtil.getInstrumentationConfig(...)` returns `empty()`, making `v3Preview` always `false` even if users set `-Dotel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview=true` (which `SemconvStability` now honors). This can cause `AgentCommonConfig.get().getUserConfig()` to keep reading legacy `enduser.*` flags and disable identity capture / instrumentation modules unexpectedly in v3 preview mode.

replies.body: In the agent, classic (system-property) configuration is wrapped in an ExtendedOpenTelemetrySdkWrapper backed by ConfigPropertiesBackedConfigProvider, so commonConfig.getBoolean("v3_preview") already resolves through the config bridge to otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview. CommonConfig is built lazily after that wrapper is installed, so there is no early-init gap here. SemconvStability needs the ConfigPropertiesUtil fallback only because it reads config from a static initializer (via GlobalOpenTelemetry.getOrNoop()) that can run before the wrapper exists. The only non-extended path for CommonConfig is the standalone library with a plain SDK, where reading the deprecated system property is intentionally being removed. So no change here.
